title: Wipe edges
description: Wipe between two scenes with a coloured bar riding the moving edge; use for energetic section changes.
props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*20*/; direction?: 'left'|'right' /*'left'*/; edgeColor?: string /*'#facc15'*/; edgeWidth?: number /*24*/}
example:
import {WipeEdges} from './blocks/wipe-edges/WipeEdges.tsx';
<WipeEdges from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} direction="left" edgeColor="#facc15" />
